name: Wolf Commando
description:
About This Game

An explosive 80s-inspired top-down military shooter where skill, guts, and firepower decide everything.

You are part of the Wolf Commando—an off-the-books strike unit deployed where missions don’t exist and survival isn’t guaranteed.

Join the Wolf Commando Discord and become part of the development as we prepare for deployment.

Clear. Fast. Deadly.

Pure arcade action. No gimmicks, no confusion. Every enemy, hazard, and reward is readable at a glance, and difficulty comes from pressure—not hidden mechanics. If you fail, it’s on you—and you’ll come back stronger.

Singleplayer & Co-op

Play solo or team up in online co-op or local co-op. Wolf Commando supports both singleplayer and multiplayer modes with the same rules, intensity, and fast-paced action—just with more firepower.

Skill-Based Combat

Movement, aim, and positioning decide the outcome in this fast-paced top-down shooter. Full 360° control and responsive inputs keep you in command at all times. You are outnumbered—but mastery keeps you alive.

Hunt the Black Canopy

You’re not fighting an army—you’re hunting the Black Canopy, a shadow network that fuels conflict and disappears before it can be exposed.
Each operation takes you deeper into hostile territory. Choose your route through branching paths, play it safe, or move into high-risk encounters for greater rewards. The map stays consistent—your decisions define every attempt.

Fast-Paced Action. No Downtime

High-intensity operations built for replayability.
Encounters escalate quickly, and how long you survive depends entirely on your execution. Frequent checkpoints and instant restarts keep momentum high and the action constant.
Fail fast. Restart faster. Improve every time.

Score Attack & Replayability

Performance drives progression. Build multipliers, take bigger risks, and refine your execution to push your score higher. Compete on leaderboards and prove your mastery.

Key Features

  • Fast-paced top-down shooter with 80s action style

  • Skill-based combat with full 360° control

  • Bullet hell-inspired enemy pressure and combat intensity

  • Branching paths with risk/reward gameplay

  • Score attack systems and global leaderboards

  • Replayable, performance-driven runs

  • Singleplayer, online co-op, and local co-op

  • Boss fights
short_desc: An explosive 80s-inspired top-down military shooter where skill, guts, and firepower decide everything. Choose your route and fight for the highest score.
